# BrightCellPlanStudio

> Digital planners, spreadsheet templates, OBS stream overlays, resumes and printables from two Etsy shops run by Ricardo: BrightCellPlanStudio and SpoonfulOfCalmStudio. Many products can also be bought on this website with secure checkout. Everything sold here is a digital file; nothing is shipped.

Site: https://brightcellplanstudio.com/
Contact: brightcellplanners@gmail.com
Catalog: 1286 products (734 BrightCellPlanStudio, 552 SpoonfulOfCalmStudio).

## About the shops

- [BrightCellPlanStudio](https://www.etsy.com/shop/BrightCellPlanStudio) is the planning and productivity shop. It has Excel and Google Sheets spreadsheet templates, hyperlinked digital planners, e-ink tablet planners, planner bundles, digital planner stickers, and PowerPoint and Google Slides presentation templates. It is for people who like to plan: budgets and bills, weekly schedules and long-term goals, a small business or a pitch deck.
- [SpoonfulOfCalmStudio](https://www.etsy.com/shop/SpoonfulOfCalmStudio) is the creative and career shop. It has OBS stream overlay packs for Twitch streamers, resume and cover letter templates, and printable planners and journals. Browse them together on [SpoonfulOfCalmStudio on this site](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/spoonfulofcalm/).
- You can browse both shops here, buy many items with Buy Now checkout on this website, or follow the link on any product page to buy on Etsy.

## Categories

- [Digital Planners](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/c/digital-planners/): 456 products. Hyperlinked PDFs you write in with a stylus on a tablet. For people who want the feel of a paper planner, with tabs that jump to a month, week or section. Includes e-ink editions when the listing says so.
- [Spreadsheets](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/c/spreadsheets/): 203 products. Excel and Google Sheets templates for people who would rather type than handwrite and want the math done for them. Households tracking spending, students, freelancers and small businesses.
- [PowerPoint & Google Slides](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/c/powerpoint/): 67 products. PowerPoint and Google Slides presentation templates and infographic decks, for pitches, reports and talks.
- [Digital Stickers](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/c/stickers/): 8 products. Pre-cropped PNG planner stickers for digital planners.
- [OBS Stream Overlays](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/c/obs-overlays/): 468 products. OBS stream overlay packs for Twitch streamers, from SpoonfulOfCalmStudio.
- [Resume Templates](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/c/resume-templates/): 76 products. Resume and cover letter templates for Word and Google Docs, for students through executive roles.
- [Printables](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/c/printables/): 8 products. Printable PDF planners and journals from SpoonfulOfCalmStudio.

## Who the products are for

Taken from the published home-page copy:

- Spreadsheets: households that want to see where their money goes; students juggling deadlines; freelancers and side hustlers who need a simple record-keeping system; anyone who would rather use a sheet they can see and change themselves.
- Digital planners: people who want a paper-planner feel on a tablet, including iPad and, where the listing says so, e-ink tablets. There are life and all-in-one planners, budget and finance planners, health journals, family and wedding planners, and faith planners.
- Presentation templates: people preparing a pitch, report, lesson or talk who want a ready-made slide structure.
- Stream overlays: Twitch streamers setting up scenes, webcam frames and alerts in OBS Studio.
- Resumes: people applying for work, from student and entry-level through senior and executive roles.
- Printables: people who prefer a paper planner or journal they can print at home.

## Custom work

If a ready-made template is not the right fit, Ricardo takes on custom projects. Scope, price and timing are always agreed by email first. There is no ready-made CRM for sale; CRM work is scoped as a custom project.

- [Custom work](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/custom.html): custom spreadsheets and templates (Excel / Google Sheets); digital planners for GoodNotes and iPad; slide decks (PowerPoint / Google Slides); OBS stream overlays; resumes and cover letters; printables; and also custom CRM software, custom app development, and website design and development.
- [How to write a brief for a custom CRM, app or website project](https://brightcellplanstudio.com/guides/custom-project-brief/)
- Email: brightcellplanners@gmail.com
